reviews.comment: Visited their factory in Erattupetta before ordering The Malabar Teak 3-seater. The solid teak joinery and finish quality exceeds what you find in big brand showrooms at twice the price. Delivery was prompt and spotless.

We ordered the Vembanad L-Shape for our Bangalore apartment. Cozly sent us fabric swatches to Bangalore first via courier. The sofa arrived carefully packed and assembled in our living room. Super comfortable and sturdy!
The hydraulic sofa cum bed is genius engineering. Converts in one smooth lift. High density foam gives great sleep support for guests. Proud to support a genuine Kerala manufacturer.
Ordered the Royal Chesterfield in Royal Emerald Velvet. The tufting detail is masterclass work. WhatsApp communication was instant throughout production.
